name: Kate Damiano
source: Kate is a new main character added for the game's remake. She is a bright foreign exchange student with a captivating figure that has a playful happy-go-lucky type of personality. She instantly took a fancy to [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url] once she met him in his [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]new form[/url], which she believes to be a ninja's work. She will try her best in order to seduce him (her).
